header: THE PDF OF AN ANNOUNCEMENT (pure; nothing here touches the database or the screen). An announcement can carry ONE PDF, with or without body text: "SAIL DARPAN | Frequently Asked Questions" and the SAIL policy on sexual harassment at the workplace are announcements that are only a title and a PDF. I keep the file in Vercel Blob (the same place the circulars' and the employees' files go); its address stays on the server: the browser only ever uses our own route, GET /api/announcements/<id>/file, which is open to whoever may read the announcements (they are public on the home page). What the database holds about the file is in public.announcement_file (src/lib/nl2sql/sql/28_announcement_file.sql); the writing is in admin/files.ts and admin/store.ts.

doc: The name the reader sees and the download gets: no folders, no control characters, no quotes or slashes, at most 120 characters, always ending in .pdf. I turn an empty or hostile name into "attachment.pdf".

symbols.returns: Promise<{ body: Record<string, unknown>; file: UploadedPdf | null; tooBig: boolean }>
doc: Turns the upload form (multipart) into what the Announcement Manager's JSON endpoint takes, plus the file. The numbers of the form are text there; `removeFile` is "true" or absent. I ignore a field that is not text, and any file but the one called "file".

behaviours: a name keeps its words and always ends in .pdf (once)
a path becomes its last part, and quotes, slashes, control characters and line breaks go (no header or folder trick)
an empty or dots-only name becomes attachment.pdf, and a very long one is cut to 120 characters
a Hindi or Bengali name is kept
a real PDF with a .pdf name is accepted, under its clean name
an empty file, a missing file, a file that is not a PDF by its bytes (whatever its name), and a name that is not .pdf are all refused
the PDF header may be a little way into the file (some files start with a few bytes first)
the size limit is 10 MB: exactly 10 MB is accepted, one byte more is refused
sizes read plainly
a served file is a PDF, shown inline by default, with its length, nosniff, and a private no-cache rule
a download says attachment, and a Hindi name is sent both in a plain safe form and UTF-8 encoded (no raw non-ASCII in the header)
the route of an announcement's file is /api/announcements/<id>/file
the memory storage keeps, gives back and deletes a file
the form becomes the manager's body: id and limit are numbers, removeFile a boolean, the rest text
only the file called 'file' is taken, with its name and bytes; a file under another field name is ignored
a form with no file gives no file
a file over the limit is flagged and not read into memory
the admin route takes a multipart form as well as JSON, refuses an over-size file with 413, checks the origin first, and hands the upload to the handler
the file route serves the PDF from our own route (never a redirect to the storage address), answers 404 when there is none, and its info answer has only name and bytes
the public list adds each announcement's file (name and size) from a query of its own that cannot break the list, and never selects the address

the SQL file makes a table of its own (so the announcements work before it is run), keyed by the announcement and removed with it, with the address, name, size and who attached it, safe to run twice and closed to the browser roles
